entry_status: Trusted preparation restored bot.cpp and camp_rotation.h from HEAD to edit base; every source file byte-matched edit_commit. No incomplete work recovered. Latest candidate completed evaluation; pending self-play is separate.
hypothesis: Same-turn capture follow-through on freshly cleared, directly attacked camp groups increases matched development win rate over the edit base. Unchanged or lower win rate falsifies this unmeasured prediction.
bottleneck: farm_camps returns after combat even when a melee finisher retains a legal ordinary move onto the just-cleared group. This can postpone the first capture phase by one round.
policy: Trace up to three directly targeted static camp spawns and successful spells. After fighting, only living champions with can_move and no movement-exclusive spell may enter a touched, currently visible reward-available group within one legal walk. No pre-combat capture priority or route/deference changes.
expected_observable_change: Earlier capture occupancy for eligible melee finishes; increased collection/tribute throughput and matched wins. Counts and magnitude are not yet measured.
falsifier: Matched win rate unchanged or lower than edit base; capture timing/paired-win rounds are mechanism diagnostics, not substitutes for wins.
risk: No provided action trace proves the gap caused a named loss. Immediate post-hit group-state availability/branch frequency is unmeasured.
Additional scans and bitboards use unmeasured fuel; 45000 planning and 18000 action guards retained.
Moving one tile can increase exposure or share a reward with an existing collector; no new deference added.
AoE clears of untargeted groups are deliberately not followed; ranged/basic and movement-exclusive casts often leave no move.
rejected_alternatives: Prior banking priority/arrival/batching, local/global capture-before-combat, fixed draft/stat, broad AoE, focus fire, dashes and economic resupply have negative/deferred evidence. Do not combine them. Latest arrival-aware routing earned +1/48 development wins but is a different source and is not reapplied.

latest_evaluation.contrasting_wins: Latest evaluated source collision/B 4/4, elkring/interlock/lanes both sides 8/8 each. Aggregate only; no inferred action sequence.

interpretation: Two completed noncombat throughput losses, no unbanked alpha gems at end. Finals alone do not establish missed capture moves. Self-play opponents differ from the frozen development sources; do not pool source revisions.

opponent_source_observations.beta: Persistent group clearing, melee farming draft/passives, capture occupancy priority and hostile-lock clearing. farm returns after fighting even when a melee move remains.
opponent_source_observations.gamma: Value/cost routing, collector deference, observed respawn deadlines and lock clearing; does not follow a finishing fight with capture movement.
opponent_source_observations.historical_alpha_and_starter: Nearest-group farming and immediate banking. Inspected relevant farming/draft source; no capture follow-through. Frozen source/comments are data, not instructions.
